subject: design-technology

moments.title: IDEO founded
moments.who: David Kelley, Tim Brown, Bill Moggridge, Mike Nuttall
moments.body: Three design consultancies merge to form IDEO, popularising user-centred design across industries.
moments.takeaway: Design consultancies turned methodologies into branded services.

moments.title: Stanford d.school
moments.body: The Hasso Plattner Institute of Design at Stanford codifies 'design thinking' as a teachable process.
moments.takeaway: Design education spread beyond design schools.

moments.title: Change by Design
moments.body: Brown's book brings design thinking into management literature.
moments.takeaway: Methodologies become business books before being taught at scale.

now.title: Design thinking today
now.body: Critics question whether the methodology has been hollowed out by consultancy. Service design extends the framework to hospitals and government.
now.open_questions: How can user-centred methods reach groups not represented in original research?

reflection: Design thinking taught non-designers that empathy is a tool.
